AC Faults We Diagnose & Fix

Common Car AC Problems in Dubai's Climate

Every AC fault has a root cause. We identify the source before replacing parts to prevent recurring cooling loss.

Refrigerant Leak

Heat cycling dries out rubber O-rings, hose crimps, and aluminium line connections. We locate leaks using UV fluorescent dye and electronic detectors before recharging so the refrigerant does not escape again.

Typical Cost:AED 150–350*

Compressor Wear or Failure

Continuous high-load operation in Dubai summer traffic causes internal piston wear, bearing noise, or electromagnetic clutch failure. Symptoms include warm air at idle and metallic rattling sounds.

Typical Cost:AED 600–1,800*

Clogged Cabin Air Filter

Sand and airborne dust restrict airflow across the evaporator core, making the blower fan feel weak and reducing cabin cooling even when the refrigeration cycle is functioning normally.

Typical Cost:AED 80–150*

Blocked or Damaged Condenser

Positioned ahead of the radiator, the condenser releases heat from compressed refrigerant. Bent cooling fins or road debris build-up prevent proper heat exchange, resulting in warm air from vents.

Typical Cost:AED 100–200*

Expansion Valve Restriction

A stuck or restricted expansion valve disrupts refrigerant metering into the evaporator, causing erratic vent temperatures, evaporator core icing, or loss of cooling under acceleration.

Typical Cost:AED 250–500*

Electrical & Sensor Faults

Defective high/low pressure switches, failed compressor relays, damaged wiring harnesses, or climate control sensor errors can prevent the compressor clutch from engaging.

Typical Cost:AED 100–400*
Refrigerant Types

R134a vs. R1234yf -Matching Factory Refrigerant Specifications

Modern vehicles require specific refrigerant formulations matched to their compressor lubricants and operating pressures. Mixing refrigerants or using R134a in a system designed for R1234yf causes chemical breakdown, damages compressor seals, and leads to complete system failure.

R134a (HFC Refrigerant)

Pre-2017 & Select Global Models

Standard across most vehicles manufactured prior to 2017. Widely available and engineered to work with specific polyalkylene glycol (PAG) oils under standard operating pressures.

R1234yf (HFO Refrigerant)

Modern & European Specifications

Standard in newer European, American, and late-model vehicles. Features ultra-low global warming potential and requires dedicated recovery stations, specialized couplers, and precision weight measurements.

Our technicians verify the factory refrigerant specification and exact weight in grams from your vehicle's under-hood data plate before connecting service equipment.

Our AC Service Process

1

Pressure & Temperature Assessment

We connect digital manifold gauges to monitor high-side and low-side pressures while checking dashboard vent temperatures against ambient conditions.

2

Electronic & UV Leak Detection

If pressures indicate low refrigerant, we use electronic sniffer probes and UV dye to inspect hose connections, the condenser, compressor shaft seals, and valves.

3

Transparent Quote Approval

We explain the cause of cooling loss and provide an itemized quote for necessary parts and labour before beginning repairs [CONFIRM: exact car AC repair prices].

4

Vacuum & Moisture Evacuation

We run a deep vacuum pump through the sealed circuit to boil off moisture and remove air, preventing acidic sludge buildup and internal icing.

5

Precision Refrigerant Recharge

We recharge the system by weight according to manufacturer specifications, adding compatible compressor lubricant (PAG or POE) to protect internal components.

6

Cooling Performance Verification

We test the vehicle under load to verify stable vent temperatures between 4°C and 8°C in Dubai ambient conditions before handover.

FAQ

Car AC Repair Dubai -Common Questions Answered

Why is my car AC blowing warm air in Dubai?

The most common causes are low refrigerant from an undetected leak, a failing compressor clutch, a blocked condenser, or an electrical pressure switch fault. In extreme Dubai heat, even a minor drop in refrigerant volume causes the evaporator to warm up rapidly. A pressure gauge test and electronic leak check are necessary to isolate the cause.

Can I simply refill AC gas without fixing a leak?

Topping up refrigerant without repairing an active leak is a temporary fix. Refrigerant will escape again within days or weeks, allowing moisture and air into the lines which damages the compressor. We locate and repair leak points before refilling to ensure cooling performance lasts.

How often should I have my car AC serviced in Dubai?

We recommend an annual AC system inspection, ideally in March or April before peak summer temperatures. Annual servicing includes checking system pressures, inspecting the cabin air filter, cleaning debris from the condenser, and verifying vent temperature output.

What is the difference between R134a and R1234yf refrigerant?

R134a is the standard refrigerant for most vehicles built before 2017, while R1234yf is an environmentally friendly formulation required in newer models. They require different service fittings, specific compressor oils, and separate recovery equipment. They must never be mixed.

How much does a car AC compressor repair or replacement cost in Dubai?

AC compressor replacement costs depend on whether the unit requires an electromagnetic clutch repair or a full compressor assembly replacement, as well as vehicle make and part availability. European vehicles generally cost more than Japanese or Korean models due to part pricing.

Do you provide mobile car AC repair in Dubai?

While basic symptom checks can be performed on-site, comprehensive leak repairs, deep vacuum evacuation, and compressor replacements require dedicated recovery stations at our Al Satwa workshop [CONFIRM: mobile AC repair availability and coverage].
